angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 243,495 km at 110.28 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.0682 +/- 0.0445 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 110.28 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.35 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Gan et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5628 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1006L..63G/abstract): 243,495 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.36 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Gan et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5628 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1006L..63G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3310 +/- 100 K from Gan et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5628 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1006L..63G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Gan et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5628 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1006L..63G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-5628-a.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.906, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5628 A (pscomppars): spectral type M3.0&plusmn1.0, from Gan et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1006L..63G/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5628 A (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.1 dex, from Gan et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1006L..63G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5628 A (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.88, from Calculated Value (/docs/pscp_calc.html)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5628 A (pscomppars): rotation period 27.9 d, from Gan et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1006L..63G/abstract)
